2609.18935.title: Long-Lived Characters, Local Inference: Incremental Memory Maintenance for Game NPCs
2609.18935.paper_summary: A game character should not have to reread its entire life before every conversation. For locally deployed language-model characters, however, revising a few memories can invalidate a long reusable prefix. The resulting preparation cost competes with both foreground dialogue and the maintenance of other characters. This matters especially when dialogue feeds game-defined actions and value judgments: a fluent but incorrect account of who owns an item, or whether a transfer has already happened, can corrupt the input to otherwise deterministic rules. We study incremental memory maintenance for long-lived game NPCs in a quantized Qwen hybrid recurrent-attention model. Our runtime removes superseded attention KV entries, computes replacement records at the true sequence tail, and preserves the continuing recurrent state and unchanged KV. Existing local experiments combine multi-update dialogue replays, fixed-input placement ablations, and attention diagnostics. Independent block composition weakens query-conditioned memory selection without a uniform chunk-initial attention collapse. True-tail updates preserve important current-state and historical bindings across eight scripted maintenance rounds; a placement case recovers the full-refill quantity in three reconstructions, while slot-preserving alternatives repeat a double-subtraction error. Attention-distribution proximity alone does not explain these semantic differences. The results motivate treating a character's inference state as a maintained, history-dependent resource, rather than only a disposable encoding of its latest memory text.
2609.18935.paper_summary_zh: 一個遊戲角色不應該在每次對話前都重讀其整個生命。然而，對於本地部署的語言模型角色，修訂幾個記憶可能會使長期可重用的前綴失效。這導致的準備成本與前景對話以及其他角色的維護相競爭。這一點尤其重要，當對話影響遊戲定義的行動和價值判斷時：流利但不正確的物品擁有者描述，或轉移是否已經發生，可能會破壞對其他確定性規則的輸入。我們研究了在量化的Qwen混合循環注意力模型中，長壽命遊戲NPC的增量記憶維護。我們的運行時刪除了過時的注意力KV條目，在真實序列尾部計算替代記錄，並保留持續的循環狀態和未改變的KV。現有的本地實驗結合了多次更新的對話重播、固定輸入位置的消融實驗和注意力診斷。獨立區塊組合削弱了查詢條件的記憶選擇，而沒有統一的區塊初始注意力崩潰。真實尾部更新在八輪腳本維護中保留了重要的當前狀態和歷史綁定；一個位置案例在三次重建中恢復了完整的補充數量，而保留插槽的替代方案則重複了雙重減法錯誤。僅僅注意力分佈的接近性並不能解釋這些語義差異。這些結果促使我們將角色的推理狀態視為一種維護的、依賴歷史的資源，而不僅僅是其最新記憶文本的可處置編碼。
